STAND_TO_WALK.entry_preconditions: STAND hold valid and requested WALK speed is supported
STAND_TO_WALK.completion_condition: WALK expert acceptance: sustained support switching, target acquisition, upright posture, bounded heading/slip/saturation
STAND_TO_WALK.abort_condition: fall, unsafe contact, saturation, timeout, or target acceptance impossible

WALK_TO_STAND.entry_preconditions: WALK hold valid and STOP path resolves through this edge
WALK_TO_STAND.completion_condition: for 0.4 s: horizontal speed <=0.08 m/s, abs vertical speed <=0.05 m/s, heading error <=0.12 rad, abs roll/pitch <=0.10 rad, double support, no flight, and no support switch for 0.4 s
WALK_TO_STAND.abort_condition: fall, reverse motion, support loss, saturation, or timeout

WALK_TO_RUN.entry_preconditions: WALK@1.2 held >=1.0 s with speed error <=0.20 m/s, heading error <=0.12 rad, and no safety failure
WALK_TO_RUN.completion_condition: speed ratio >=0.75, speed error <=0.20 m/s, heading <=0.12 rad, >=4 flights, >=3 consecutive safe cycles, >=80% alternating and valid landings, mean flight 0.04-0.16 s, and no safety failure
WALK_TO_RUN.abort_condition: fall, torso contact, dangerous slip, impact failure, long-dwell saturation, invalid action, or timeout

RUN_TO_WALK.entry_preconditions: RUN and WALK steady-state contracts are formally available
